comparison.objective: Rock a named fuse from spring clips with an insulated puller; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Select and operate a tong puller, grip the fuse body, lever each end free, and place it versus hex-key alignment, counterholding, collar tuning, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Correct fuse removed with the tool and placed without disturbing neighbors versus safe repeated impacts and stable post-lock adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both involve small-tool engagement, but the tested extraction and commissioning abilities differ; no material rubric details are missing.
